name: ev-mobility-platform
description: EV mobility intelligence, traffic digital twin, charger IoT, and smart parking platform

scripts.prepare:packages: npm run build --workspace=@ev-mobility/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@ev-mobility/energy-engine && npm run build --workspace=@ev-mobility/route-engine && npm run build --workspace=@ev-mobility/traffic-engine && npm run build --workspace=@ev-mobility/station-ranking && npm run build --workspace=@ev-mobility/charger-reliability && npm run build --workspace=@ev-mobility/recommendation-engine
